name: Interferon-alpha antiviral effector response and cytosolic DNA sensing
rationale: All members concern innate antiviral defence (virus response, DNA sensing, IFN-alpha response, OAS, IP-10), and the IFN-alpha/OAS effector arm separates it from confusables centred on IRF3-driven IFN-beta induction and its negative regulation.

name: Presynaptic glutamate and GABA release and short-term plasticity
rationale: Members cover kainate/AMPA activation, presynaptic calcium and membrane potential, glutamate/GABA secretion and short-term potentiation, whereas confusables centre on postsynaptic receptor clustering and inhibitory synapse assembly.

name: Promotion of actin-driven leading-edge protrusion in migration
rationale: All members promote actin polymerization, lamellipodia/pseudopodia and leading-edge localization for motility, unlike confusables about Arp2/3-WAVE nucleation, filament severing/capping or negative regulation of migration.

name: Myeloid progenitor fate choice: erythroid, megakaryocytic, granulocyte-monocyte
rationale: Members span transcriptional control (RUNX1, granulopoiesis, VENTX) and positive/negative regulation of erythroid, megakaryocyte, granulocyte, monocyte and macrophage differentiation, distinct from confusables focused on HSC maintenance, terminal erythropoiesis or RUNX target programs.

core: Oxidative and hypoxic stress-induced cell death
qualifier: with plasma-membrane calcium flux and mitochondrial depolarization
name: Oxidative and hypoxic stress-induced apoptosis with calcium flux control
rationale: Members regulate H2O2-, oxidative-, hypoxia- and oxygen-glucose-deprivation-induced death, and the calcium import/export and depolarization terms separate it from ferroptosis, respiration-control and MOMP confusables.

name: Resection-based double-strand break repair and BRCA-PALB2 defects
rationale: All members concern end resection and homology-directed repair (HR, SSA, MMEJ, D-loop resolution) or their BRCA1/BRCA2/PALB2/BARD1 defects, unlike confusables centred on break sensing, classical NHEJ, Fanconi anemia or PARylation.

name: HDL particle assembly, clearance and reverse cholesterol transport
rationale: Members cover ApoA-I/ABCA1-driven HDL assembly, HDL clearance and reverse cholesterol transport, while confusables emphasise phospholipid efflux, LXR regulation and HDL/LDL remodeling.

name: Bone and tooth mineralization, osteoclast remodeling and odontogenesis
rationale: Members span bone, enamel, dentin and cementum mineralization, osteoclast regulation and odontogenesis, distinguishing it from confusables on phosphate transporters or IGF responses.

name: FGFR4-betaKlotho signaling via FRS2 and SHC adaptors
rationale: All three members concern FGFR4 adaptor cascades and betaKlotho ligand binding, whereas confusables involve other FGFRs or PI3K/PLC-gamma branches.

qualifier: p53 and DNA damage induction through execution
name: Intrinsic mitochondrial apoptosis from p53 induction to execution
rationale: Members span p53/DNA-damage-driven BH3-only activation, BAX/BAK, cytochrome c release, apoptosome and execution (DNA fragmentation, lamina breakdown, PAK-2p34), unlike confusables on death-receptor/necroptotic, senescence or p53 cell-cycle arrest programs.

name: Mitochondrial OXPHOS complex biogenesis from translation to assembly
rationale: Members cover assembly of complexes I, III, IV and ATP synthase plus mitochondrial translation elongation and inner-membrane insertion, whereas confusables describe electron transport activity or translation initiation/termination.

name: Endocytic recycling and Golgi-to-plasma membrane trafficking
rationale: Members concern endosome organization, receptor/endocytic recycling and Golgi-to-surface transport, unlike confusables on Rab/ARF signalling, constitutive secretion or retrograde endosome-to-Golgi traffic.

qualifier: chloride and bicarbonate transporters and their inherited defects
name: Epithelial chloride and bicarbonate transport and inherited transporter defects
rationale: Members cover chloride, bicarbonate and other anion transport by CFTR, SLC26, SLC4, SLC12 and sodium/proton exchangers with their channelopathies, distinct from osmotic-response, aquaporin, acidification or carbonic anhydrase confusables.

name: Na+/K+-ATPase maintenance of sodium and potassium gradients
rationale: Members concern P-type ATPase ion transport, intracellular Na+/K+ homeostasis, electrochemical gradients and glycoside response, unlike confusables on regulated Na/K channels, magnesium/paracellular transport or V-ATPase acidification.

name: BAF and CHD/NuRD ATP-dependent chromatin remodeling complexes
rationale: Most members are BAF complex variants, CHD subfamilies and NuRD interactions with stem-cell maintenance ties, distinguishing it from confusables on nucleosome assembly and histone acetylation.

name: Perivascular stromal and endothelial signature with IL-33 signaling
rationale: Members are fibroblast, perivascular and endothelial signatures with adhesion, chemotaxis and IL-33 signalling, while confusables centre on ECM/EMT, TGF-beta and fibroblast proliferation.

name: Thymocyte selection, T cell differentiation and activation
rationale: Members cover thymocyte proliferation, apoptosis, positive/negative selection, Treg development and T cell activation signatures, unlike confusables on proximal TCR/CD28 signalling or B cell/Tfh differentiation.

qualifier: fructose, galactose and glycerol with inborn errors
name: Fructose, galactose and glycerol metabolism and inborn errors
rationale: Members cover fructose, Leloir galactose and glycerol/alditol pathways with their enzyme deficiencies, distinct from pentose phosphate, glycolysis/glycogen or disaccharide digestion confusables.

qualifier: fission-fusion, protein localization and membrane potential
name: Regulation of mitochondrial fission-fusion, protein localization, membrane potential
rationale: Members regulate mitochondrial fission/fusion, protein localization to mitochondria and membrane potential, unlike confusables on apoptotic MOMP, PINK1-Parkin mitophagy or import/cristae machinery.

name: Sympathoadrenal development and norepinephrine/epinephrine biosynthesis
rationale: Members link noradrenaline/adrenaline synthesis to sympathetic ganglion, noradrenergic neuron and adrenal development, unlike confusables on monoamine degradation, serotonin, neuroblast proliferation or enteric neural crest.

core: Mitochondrial acetyl-CoA and TCA cycle metabolism
qualifier: pyruvate dehydrogenase and coenzyme A synthesis
name: Pyruvate dehydrogenase, coenzyme A synthesis and TCA cycle
rationale: Members cover PDH-mediated pyruvate oxidation, CoA/pantothenate synthesis and TCA intermediates, distinct from confusables on OGDH/lipoylation, carboxylate transport or Fe-S/ATP synthesis.

name: Male meiotic recombination, synapsis and spermatid differentiation
rationale: Members cover meiotic DSB formation, synapsis and recombination in male meiosis I plus Sertoli barrier, manchette and sperm mitochondria, unlike confusables on fertilization, gonadal hormones or female meiotic segregation.

qualifier: germinal center, memory and plasma cell fates
name: B cell differentiation into germinal center, memory, plasma cells
rationale: Members are B cell, memory and plasma cell signatures with germinal center, Tfh/ICOS help and humoral memory, distinct from confusables on proximal BCR signalling or T cell development.

core: Cytokine-driven innate lymphocyte and myeloid activation
name: IL-15/IL-21 signaling, NK cell expansion and myeloid NF-kB activation
rationale: Members cover IL-15/IL-21 signalling, NK differentiation/proliferation and NF-kB-driven myeloid/DC and TNF/IL-23 activation, unlike confusables on common-gamma-chain T cell cytokines, IL-10/IL-12 family or type 2 responses.

qualifier: B cell receptor signaling and its tuning
name: B cell receptor signaling and B cell development, proliferation
rationale: Members combine proximal BCR signalling (second messengers, RAS, BTK, CD22) and its positive/negative regulation with B cell development, proliferation and homeostasis, distinct from confusables on GC/plasma-cell signatures, T cell programs or Fc receptor signalling.
